entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request establishment of bearers for user data or signalling

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure

entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Extended version of service request message supporting additional service types

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: Network response message indicating acceptance of service request

entities.name: Service Type Information Element
entities.description: IE indicating the type of service requested (e.g., CS fallback, packet services)

entities.name: EPS Bearer Context Status
entities.description: IE indicating the status of EPS bearer contexts

entities.name: Paging Restriction IE
entities.description: Information element for paging restriction control

entities.name: Timer T3417
entities.description: Timer used during service request procedure

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state indicating UE is registered with network

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: EMM state indicating UE is registered but no cell is available

entities.name: CS fallback accepted by UE
entities.description: Condition where UE accepts CS fallback procedure

entities.name: Local EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: Property where network or UE deactivates EPS bearer contexts without peer-to-peer signalling

relations.description: Service request procedure involves sending SERVICE REQUEST message
Service request procedure can involve sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message contains Service Type IE
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message may contain EPS Bearer Context Status IE
Service request procedure involves receiving SERVICE ACCEPT message
Successful completion of service request procedure stops timer T3417
Successful service request procedure establishes EMM-REGISTERED state
Service Type IE guards CS fallback procedures when CS fallback is accepted
EPS Bearer Context Status IE triggers local deactivation of bearer contexts
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message may contain Paging Restriction IE
Service request procedure for CS fallback cases establishes EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state
